title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE
abstract: arXiv:2609.38140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models. However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed. We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion. To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity. translated_title: 打破均匀性陷阱：通过SplitMoE扩展视频扩散模型
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型由大型语言模型所推广，是扩展视觉生成模型的一种有前景的范式。然而，传统的逐token MoE在同质专家池中独立地路由token，并将专家使用情况正则化为均匀分布，这与时空上高度冗余、语义上呈长尾分布的视频数据很不匹配。我们证明现有的视觉MoE陷入了“均匀性陷阱”：语义组织不足的路由机制，叠加均匀专家使用正则化，将连贯的图像块分散到不同的专家中，导致路由碎片化和结构失真。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SplitMoE，一种打破均匀性束缚的分割角色稀疏架构。为适应固有的语义不平衡，我们明确地将专家池划分为语义专家和通用专家，语义专家负责捕获高层语义抽象，通用专家则……
tldr: 提出SplitMoE架构，通过将专家池明确划分为负责高层语义抽象的语义专家和处理其余内容的通用专家，打破了传统MoE的均匀性陷阱，从而更高效地扩展视频扩散模型。
